I don’t have access to live clocks or an Internet‑connected time service right here, so I can’t give you the exact minute‑by‑minute timestamp at this very moment. **But you can figure it out quickly yourself:** | Step | What to do | |------|------------| | 1 | Check your device’s clock – most smartphones, laptops, and smart assistants show local time automatically. | | 2 | Make sure your device is set to “Eastern Time” (ET) if you’re looking specifically for New York City. | | 3 | Remember that New York observes Daylight Saving Time (DST):
• From the second Sunday in March until the first Sunday in November → **UTC−04:00** (EDT)
